metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: RISSOF crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2. Reported CIF formula moiety: 0.5(C92 H136 Eu4 N14 O22 2+),0.5(C92 H134 Eu4 N14 O22),N1 O3 1-,6.1(C1 H4 O1),7.7(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 5 O neighbors; Eu2 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu3 (Eu) has 5 O neighbors; Eu4 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.863-4.139 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 108.71-116.44°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Eu4(HL^R)2(CO3)2(NO3)2(H2O)4]0.5[Eu4(L^R)2(CO3)2(NO3)2(H2O)4]0.5(NO3)·6.1CH3OH·7.7H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
